Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 44, "heading": "CHAPTER 42. MISCHIEF", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u044-b0062", "target": "Никогда, никогда я не любил Дору так глубоко и искренне, как любил её в ту ночь. Когда мы снова сошли и шли при свете звёзд по тихой дороге, ведущей к дому доктора, я сказал Агнес, что это её заслуга.", "source_sha256": "cc5491fb828b0082d0f5c7c51f0d1a3420ef7f611864eae63b86322cb5ae849c", "target_id": "ru-en85-u044-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d0601b7f8c8c38dc4c8084fbceb0bd76a342ec1c612c01f3eb74621a66697538"}, {"source_id": "en85-u044-b0063", "target": "— Когда вы сидели возле неё, — сказал я, — вы казались ничуть не меньше её ангелом-хранителем, чем моим; и вы кажетесь им теперь, Агнес.", "source_sha256": "0fa9c8ca9753089236607a9ff30ceae0e5fcae297dde9293c6cf684a10da1d37", "target_id": "ru-en85-u044-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f07e5b0982671aed420544f22ce20f0db7286ac3780b5b16e1c053abd72a2202"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 42, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u044-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A poor angel,’ she returned, ‘but faithful.’", "sha256": "cb3bfe48562df9385fb89d0fba458e682a1cf21db5b17f6e72d71953b9193c52", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The clear tone of her voice, going straight to my heart, made it natural to me to say:", "sha256": "acbbb2e4cad15951647547dafd99dc88ba721a333bcc4b444d76926b00557f7d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The cheerfulness that belongs to you, Agnes (and to no one else that ever I have seen), is so restored, I have observed today, that I have begun to hope you are happier at home?’", "sha256": "c436d1e158235566b495d2fcba22080f2c1d72cbe1c9d7f99f52e372d150c6ad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am happier in myself,’ she said; ‘I am quite cheerful and light-hearted.’", "sha256": "65a5e4cbfd478416cd4667826c51681b64ee9dc89c674a7896d01cd8d9de5a5d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I glanced at the serene face looking upward, and thought it was the stars that made it seem so noble.", "sha256": "efc3d44891ae8869583e56088b17c76a1f4f810c17ea907c3d63e1f2317236ec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There has been no change at home,’ said Agnes, after a few moments.", "sha256": "001d761caebd2507638153bf2806a081324c0a61020912d97026a313a04e77bc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No fresh reference,’ said I, ‘to—I wouldn’t distress you, Agnes, but I cannot help asking—to what we spoke of, when we parted last?’", "sha256": "91e2204604cd90399dfd82f22e3af7b3373a281f640f2c18341b29490f0c8fb5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, none,’ she answered.", "sha256": "eed1d0ab4b2b2ddeefc8cbd33987fefdaeb1c0abc8ed8b07b0ee337f799a96d5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have thought so much about it.’", "sha256": "48a82c58b64ff6fb53e32c08ff752009177e0d3e345a52c1da224fbd0469f8e1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You must think less about it. Remember that I confide in simple love and truth at last. Have no apprehensions for me, Trotwood,’ she added, after a moment; ‘the step you dread my taking, I shall never take.’", "sha256": "a4fcd9526a211c60d0a02cf77782fb26f23e7a3df74ad31ae6dc7731d5fa4a1f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Although I think I had never really feared it, in any season of cool reflection, it was an unspeakable relief to me to have this assurance from her own truthful lips. I told her so, earnestly.", "sha256": "0f6a610a9cde359f1831c01c6a46d26fc4f3e349feab3bf4cd914fa8461123af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And when this visit is over,’ said I,—‘for we may not be alone another time,—how long is it likely to be, my dear Agnes, before you come to London again?’", "sha256": "a5fc32df0c9ad77b7339026fdd025f52544ae9ffcd5170bffbcf63682186e890", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0076", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Probably a long time,’ she replied; ‘I think it will be best—for papa’s sake—to remain at home. We are not likely to meet often, for some time to come; but I shall be a good correspondent of Dora’s, and we shall frequently hear of one another that way.’", "sha256": "6eb7cbceb0abb5e09c0dcd61ef9f0ced3787d854135e295194ef2984ae2b04bf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[76]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0077", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We were now within the little courtyard of the Doctor’s cottage. It was growing late. There was a light in the window of Mrs. Strong’s chamber, and Agnes, pointing to it, bade me good night.", "sha256": "1e33653992b5d6432ef82d5cbab022748a14b6ca85015434cdbc037aad6413e4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[77]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0078", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do not be troubled,’ she said, giving me her hand, ‘by our misfortunes and anxieties. I can be happier in nothing than in your happiness. If you can ever give me help, rely upon it I will ask you for it. God bless you always!’ In her beaming smile, and in these last tones of her cheerful voice, I seemed again to see and hear my little Dora in her company. I stood awhile, looking through the porch at the stars, with a heart full of love and gratitude, and then walked slowly forth. I had engaged a bed at a decent alehouse close by, and was going out at the gate, when, happening to turn my head, I saw a light in the Doctor’s study. A half-reproachful fancy came into my mind, that he had been working at the Dictionary without my help. With the view of seeing if this were so, and, in any case, of bidding him good night, if he were yet sitting among his books, I turned back, and going softly across the hall, and gently opening the door, looked in.", "sha256": "b6b401f24db9804bfa8b3ab44650591f4b88dc644ba86d1b4ab9a640dd92db64", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[78]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0079", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The first person whom I saw, to my surprise, by the sober light of the shaded lamp, was Uriah. He was standing close beside it, with one of his skeleton hands over his mouth, and the other resting on the Doctor’s table. The Doctor sat in his study chair, covering his face with his hands. Mr. Wickfield, sorely troubled and distressed, was leaning forward, irresolutely touching the Doctor’s arm.", "sha256": "b3fb5e9810ec0c9206c673d49513067baac32b20049ab999efcc6a88aa997a69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[79]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0080", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "For an instant, I supposed that the Doctor was ill. I hastily advanced a step under that impression, when I met Uriah’s eye, and saw what was the matter. I would have withdrawn, but the Doctor made a gesture to detain me, and I remained.", "sha256": "e25636b4dcec70bda14b4486751c115054fa5b2ae0eafbd8f3836e276ed577fe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[80]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0081", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘At any rate,’ observed Uriah, with a writhe of his ungainly person, ‘we may keep the door shut. We needn’t make it known to ALL the town.’", "sha256": "42cdf862c156e145c41da3114570b2b321007190c8f92dfdcdff38ec3815d1e9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[81]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0082", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Saying which, he went on his toes to the door, which I had left open, and carefully closed it. He then came back, and took up his former position. There was an obtrusive show of compassionate zeal in his voice and manner, more intolerable—at least to me—than any demeanour he could have assumed.", "sha256": "26cbbf6eae50eb6e6361ce084654cf5fb27b254804b134ce467e085d32d36a16", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[82]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0083", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have felt it incumbent upon me, Master Copperfield,’ said Uriah, ‘to point out to Doctor Strong what you and me have already talked about. You didn’t exactly understand me, though?’", "sha256": "db7ba1ee64999a46d1b9c239cbe84832fc00c321f7ec8a764c030ed818cfffe9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[83]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0084", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I gave him a look, but no other answer; and, going to my good old master, said a few words that I meant to be words of comfort and encouragement. He put his hand upon my shoulder, as it had been his custom to do when I was quite a little fellow, but did not lift his grey head.", "sha256": "769ea4da37c7513015be23a083452d0b863de2445bfaa57a98f62aeb1d55daf3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[84]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0085", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘As you didn’t understand me, Master Copperfield,’ resumed Uriah in the same officious manner, ‘I may take the liberty of umbly mentioning, being among friends, that I have called Doctor Strong’s attention to the goings-on of Mrs. Strong. It’s much against the grain with me, I assure you, Copperfield, to be concerned in anything so unpleasant; but really, as it is, we’re all mixing ourselves up with what oughtn’t to be. That was what my meaning was, sir, when you didn’t understand me.’ I wonder now, when I recall his leer, that I did not collar him, and try to shake the breath out of his body.", "sha256": "522b95652ee198c8ba136ce0855092734930c84055d79bb11c0573295a0d41c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[85]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0086", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I dare say I didn’t make myself very clear,’ he went on, ‘nor you neither. Naturally, we was both of us inclined to give such a subject a wide berth. Hows’ever, at last I have made up my mind to speak plain; and I have mentioned to Doctor Strong that—did you speak, sir?’", "sha256": "b0732b66b74940deeee6d68596e6a8c9ce9ee928a149863dde4a3546656600dd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[86]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0087", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "This was to the Doctor, who had moaned. The sound might have touched any heart, I thought, but it had no effect upon Uriah’s.", "sha256": "c652cc52b387cdb0e3bd9de6375285a014d1e172fcb02e9f2e856a1d782c3414", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[87]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0088", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘—mentioned to Doctor Strong,’ he proceeded, ‘that anyone may see that Mr. Maldon, and the lovely and agreeable lady as is Doctor Strong’s wife, are too sweet on one another. Really the time is come (we being at present all mixing ourselves up with what oughtn’t to be), when Doctor Strong must be told that this was full as plain to everybody as the sun, before Mr. Maldon went to India; that Mr. Maldon made excuses to come back, for nothing else; and that he’s always here, for nothing else. When you come in, sir, I was just putting it to my fellow-partner,’ towards whom he turned, ‘to say to Doctor Strong upon his word and honour, whether he’d ever been of this opinion long ago, or not. Come, Mr. Wickfield, sir! Would you be so good as tell us? Yes or no, sir? Come, partner!’", "sha256": "9c54cd4f8247cbb6beb66dac32a7f4f61b47ebc5784cf5d7a5d071a6c8e914f3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[88]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0089", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘For God’s sake, my dear Doctor,’ said Mr. Wickfield again laying his irresolute hand upon the Doctor’s arm, ‘don’t attach too much weight to any suspicions I may have entertained.’", "sha256": "a244ac24e2ada42268bc0e2885f80355bcd2f843b4df34be8c7afa97e28df6f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[89]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0090", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There!’ cried Uriah, shaking his head. ‘What a melancholy confirmation: ain’t it? Him! Such an old friend! Bless your soul, when I was nothing but a clerk in his office, Copperfield, I’ve seen him twenty times, if I’ve seen him once, quite in a taking about it—quite put out, you know (and very proper in him as a father; I’m sure I can’t blame him), to think that Miss Agnes was mixing herself up with what oughtn’t to be.’", "sha256": "b60c972f3b563baafc78eefe0bbadd5d92c5c74e528c0d418796286b369d758e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[90]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0091", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear Strong,’ said Mr. Wickfield in a tremulous voice, ‘my good friend, I needn’t tell you that it has been my vice to look for some one master motive in everybody, and to try all actions by one narrow test. I may have fallen into such doubts as I have had, through this mistake.’", "sha256": "e5854e1ff8161ea114aece1bb8459c55013ca08b28e7cba8095319a6ca03d6b6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[91]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0092", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You have had doubts, Wickfield,’ said the Doctor, without lifting up his head. ‘You have had doubts.’", "sha256": "2ff1e318dee4f17953821b480d597a62086ed019de6dec0c9b0eacb4511ce8fc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[92]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0093", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Speak up, fellow-partner,’ urged Uriah.", "sha256": "de7eca451baf83db35fd994385287a478bd02ebbd37edd4f309f9967772a5165", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[93]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0094", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I had, at one time, certainly,’ said Mr. Wickfield. ‘I—God forgive me—I thought YOU had.’", "sha256": "80311ae0b963773f1e8c6b5e7802dd28ddf513bfd498898645610d9efc78f49f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[94]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u044-b0095", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, no, no!’ returned the Doctor, in a tone of most pathetic grief. ‘I thought, at one time,’ said Mr. Wickfield, ‘that you wished to send Maldon abroad to effect a desirable separation.’", "sha256": "ac687e73077005756db6bd88db1dc16f97025deb5b9cc1777a792aedb2dd40f7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[49]/p[95]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
